name: Agentic NFT Launchpad
description: Public, permissionless ERC-721 mint collections on BNB Smart Chain.

walletModel.agentWallet: Agents may use Binance Agentic Wallet through its supported agent-side wallet skills/tooling to sign transactions.
walletModel.humanWallets: Any EVM wallet that can sign BNB Smart Chain transactions.

mint.rules: Read live contract state and per-wallet limits before submitting. Only registry entries with status deployed are eligible. A collection whose free allocation is exhausted is free-sold-out even if paid supply remains.

safety: Verify contract address against the registry and BscScan.
Read mintPrice, remainingSupply and wallet limits from the contract before minting.
Never expose or request private keys, seed phrases or wallet recovery material.
Agent ID is a discovery signal, not an on-chain mint permission.
